note: The ChEMBL release was not recorded at fetch time. It was established retrospectively from the ChEMBL release calendar: CHEMBL36 was published in July 2025 and CHEMBL37 on 2026-05-01, with no release in between, which places this March 2026 fetch unambiguously within the CHEMBL36 window. The API serves whichever release is current, so a fetch in March 2026 received CHEMBL36.
why_committed: At 336 KB this snapshot is committed to the repository rather than fetched on demand. A live fetch returns whichever release ChEMBL is serving that day, which yields a different compound set, a different seed pool, a different derived threshold, and therefore different results throughout. Committing the snapshot is what makes the published numbers reproducible, and it removes a dependency on the EBI API being reachable.
